summary: T2-01 round 4: all three story checks exit 0 (330 tests pass, mypy clean, make check clean). The diff touches only story-listed files. I read the code for each acceptance criterion and found no defect. The earlier mask-loss and float64-range fixes are in the code (_require_plain at polarimetry.py:235, mark_out_of_range at :192). I did not re-verify the failing-first history this round. Round 1 covered it.

checks.criterion: mypy strict on src and tests
checks.evidence: Success: no issues found in 5 source files
ruff check passed, ruff format --check passed, mypy: no issues found in 6 source files

checks.criterion: numpy added, uv.lock updated, no other dependency
checks.evidence: Only numpy>=2.5,<3 added to pyproject.toml, with matching uv.lock entries. scipy not added.

checks.criterion: ObsState three states, InvalidReason string codes, every function returns value, state and reason, with no NaN-as-zero or 0-as-missing
checks.evidence: The StatedArray validator (polarimetry.py:163-169) requires reason NONE exactly where state is VALID, and NaN in every non-VALID element.

checks.criterion: F8, F9, F10 values and the tolerances
checks.evidence: decode_db computes 20*log10(DN)-83, decode_linear computes (DN*10**(-83/20))**2, x_power computes (HV/HH)**2, angle_to_degrees uses np.degrees. All are exercised by the 330 passing tests.

checks.criterion: DN=0 and nodata handling, and x_power DENOMINATOR_INVALID with no epsilon
checks.evidence: _classify_dn (polarimetry.py:346-368) marks nodata MISSING and zero INVALID/DN_ZERO. x_power (:497-500) marks DENOMINATOR_INVALID and adds no epsilon.

checks.criterion: Angle conversion requires an explicit unit and raises on any other value or on None
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:535-536 raises ValueError unless unit is 'radians' or 'degrees'. Conversion to degrees is documented in the docstring.

checks.criterion: Hypothesis property tests, and named constants for the offset and nodata
checks.evidence: Hypothesis tests are in the passing suite. PALSAR2_CALIBRATION_OFFSET_DB = 83.0 is a named constant (:339), and nodata is an explicit required argument.
